headline: Brent Crude Heads for Third Weekly Loss as Ample Global Supply Counteracts War Risks
summary: Brent crude futures fell 1% to $90.80 per barrel, positioning benchmark oil for its third consecutive weekly decline. Expanding global crude output outweighed market jitters regarding potential military escalations between the US and Iran.
why: Brent crude is the international benchmark for physical oil trading, directly affecting global transport fuel prices and energy sector corporate earnings.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Rising global crude supply projections pushed benchmark oil futures downward.
